Ottimo acquisto. K Kieran Martin Great while it lasted. Died after ~14 months. I got this SSD in October 2020. It worked great as a Windows drive, never had any issues. It's now January 2022, and a few days ago I started getting BSODs. After restarting, I would need to update the UEFI settings to boot from the drive. It was like the drive had been disconnected and reconnected.Time between BSODs started decreasing, and soon I couldn't even boot to Windows. The drive was still visible in the UEFI, and I was able to boot into Linux, but could not see the drive there.After a few hours of being unable to boot off the drive and trying different things, I restarted and my computer wouldn't even post. It hung at the initial motherboard manufacturer logo screen. Popped out the drive and it resumed posting normally.Conveniently, there's a 1 year warranty. So I guess it lasted as long as intended. I even got 2 bonus months. /sI'm going to try ordering a USB enclosure and see if I can get anything of it, but I'm not getting my hopes up. Learn from my mistakes: stick to reputable brands, and backup your data regularly. J Jayden Hunt Great while it lasted. Died after ~14 months. I got this SSD in October 2020.
